channel: original Array1-01 only; no gain, normalization, beamforming, channel search or resampling

scorer.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, remove Unicode categories P/S; whitespace split

support: complete official speaker segment href-resolved lexical words; first lexical start to last lexical end; decimal arithmetic floor(start*16000), ceil(end*16000); no added padding; no splitting or joining
eligibility: all referenced lexical words present; finite nonnegative monotone starts and ends, each end >= start; duration 2 through 19.6 seconds inclusive after outward sample rounding; at least 8 normalized words; no gap, transformerror or undecipherable text; unknown tags/attributes stop review

annotation_only_marker_inventory.disfmarker: omit empty disfluency annotation node, retain lexical disfluencies/repetitions
vocalsound: phonetic sound for d repeated four times

lexical_attributes: trunc=true, mispronounced=true, pron=foreign retained as transcribed, never corrected; punc=true only explicit inventory
overlap: exclude sample-rounded support with positive intersection against any other speaker official transcriber segment containing w lexical, gap or transformerror; no word-level narrowing of other-speaker segments; lexical/gap/error nonoverlap only, NOT acoustically clean: competing pure laughter/nonverbal sound remains allowed under unchanged v1 policy
strata: per meeting original-channel PCM RMS across every eligible segment. Order by (RMS, SHA256 selection key) ascending; quiet ranks [0,floor(N/4)), ordinary ranks [floor(N/4),floor(3N/4)); top quartile excluded. Rank convention explicitly handles ties deterministically.
selection: seed ami-english-farfield-v2-20261010; SHA256(seed|meeting|stratum|segment_id), UTF-8. Within each stratum select minimum current speaker count among speakers with a remaining feasible candidate, then smallest candidate hash. Alternate quiet then ordinary one at a time until 6 each or no feasible candidates. Selected sample supports mutually nonoverlapping within meeting.
admission: all five fixed meetings; >=4 quiet and >=4 ordinary each; >=480 total normalized reference words; at most60. Shortfalls stop inference; never substitute meetings or loosen rules.
metrics: qualified lexical WER and fixed N; deterministic Levenshtein S/D/I (prefer match, substitution, deletion, insertion on backtrace ties) with sum checked against lexical; pooled overall, quiet, ordinary; per meeting; equal-meeting macro; five leave-one-meeting-out pooled deltas; utterance wins/ties/losses; raw failures/truncations/repetition suspicion/status language
language: both Qwen candidate and SenseVoice baseline retain automatic language settings
engineering_advance_gate: all calls successful and untruncated; no Qwen repetition suspicion; Qwen overall/quiet/ordinary WER each <= baseline; >=4/5 meetings nonregressing; no meeting >3 percentage-point degradation; every leave-one-meeting-out pooled result nonregressing
interpretation: conservative engineering screen, not population statistical noninferiority. Pass permits continuous end-to-end evaluation only, never default promotion. Historical model training overlap unknown; some meetings appeared in old repository evaluations; prospectively frozen comparison, NOT unseen holdout. Word timings forced-aligned, annotation-assisted/oracle crops, NOT manually exact word-boundary gold. Segment overlap exclusion conservatively rejects some non-simultaneous speech. Original failed v1 is separately retained as failed-cohort evidence, never pooled into v2 primary gates. No punctuation-based sentence slicing.

meeting_screen.universe: All 171 meetings with words XML in the official annotations ZIP pinned in pins.json; metadata from that same ZIP.
meeting_screen.eligibility: exclude original5; >=20 complete strict segment candidates; zero mutually overlapping candidate pairs; no unknown node tags; metadata.duration exists; no parse errors; exact v1 attribute/Decimal validation must confirm proposed5 before acquisition
meeting_screen.ordering: ascending SHA256 UTF-8 of ami-english-v2-supplement-20261010|<meeting>; take first5; no alternate seeds tried; no audio/output-based swaps
meeting_screen.screening_bias: annotation-only sufficiency selects meetings with more complete solo segments and valid annotations, not random/population representativeness; historical training overlap remains unknown
meeting_screen.later_failure: stop and report if metadata/header duration discrepancy, invalid source/channel/crop, or insufficient frozen counts; never silently replace meetings or loosen rules

amendments.timing: Declared and independently reviewed before RMS selection or inference
amendments.rule: Verified original RIFF frame count and sample rate govern crop bounds; summary metadata duration remains provenance. Exclude entire out-of-bounds candidates. Never clip, shift, stretch, pad, split, change XML timings or replace meetings. A duration discrepancy is not evidence of an offset, and no acoustic alignment correction was made.
